name: Mindpath Health
one_liner: A psychiatry and therapy group practice with offices in several states and video visits, plus TMS and esketamine for hard-to-treat depression.
best_for: Adults who want a psychiatrist or nurse practitioner for medication, billed to insurance
People with depression that has not improved on medication who want to look at TMS or esketamine
People who want the option of in-person or video visits in the same practice
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988, or call 911
People outside the states where Mindpath has clinicians
Uninsured people who need a price up front (self-pay rates are not published)
short_description: A multi-state psychiatry and therapy practice offering in-person and video care, medication management, TMS and esketamine, mostly through insurance.
long_description: Mindpath Health is a large outpatient mental health group practice formed when Community Psychiatry and MindPath Care Centers merged. It offers psychiatric evaluation and medication management, talk therapy, transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS, an FDA-cleared treatment for depression and OCD), and esketamine treatment in California, Florida and North Carolina. Care is in person at its offices or online. A 2023 report described about 98 locations in Arizona, California, Florida, North Carolina, South Carolina and Texas, with about three quarters of visits by telehealth; its LinkedIn page also lists Ohio. A separate Mindpath College Health team serves students near California campuses. Most visits are billed to commercial insurance, and accepted plans vary by location; uninsured patients can self-pay, but rates are not published, so ask for a Good Faith Estimate. No published study of Mindpath's own services was found.

pricing.starting_price: Copay with insurance; self-pay rates not published
pricing.notes: In-network with many commercial plans (e.g. Aetna, BCBS, Cigna, Humana, UnitedHealthcare/Optum; varies by location). Uninsured patients can self-pay and can request a Good Faith Estimate under the No Surprises Act. Billing line listed on its California page: 877-611-3974.

privacy.notes: California notice (May 2026) says it has not sold or shared personal information for cross-context behavioral advertising in the past 12 months; clinical records are covered by its HIPAA notice. A general deletion right for all users was not confirmed.

faqs.q: What is Mindpath Health and who is it for?
faqs.a: Mindpath Health is a digital health platform designed to support mental health and wellness.

faqs.q: How much does Mindpath Health cost?
faqs.a: Mindpath Health pricing varies. Contact them for current pricing.

faqs.q: Is Mindpath Health covered by insurance?
faqs.a: Coverage varies by plan. Check with your insurance provider or the platform directly.

primary_uses: Esketamine (Spravato) for treatment-resistant depression in CA, FL and NC

patient_summary: You book a psychiatrist, psychiatric nurse practitioner or therapist at a Mindpath office or by video, usually billed to your insurance. Mindpath also offers TMS and, in some states, esketamine (Spravato) for depression that has not responded to other treatment. Check that it has clinicians in your state and that your plan is accepted at the location you choose.

availability.note: Offices and video care in several states (reported: AZ, CA, FL, NC, SC, TX, and OH); esketamine only in CA, FL and NC. Accepted insurance varies by location.
